definition: Arena reuses Ontic worlds, existence and causes, and adds a separate sort of facts with world-relative truth, an existence-fact map, a primitive relation explains w r f, and a primitive conjunct relation. Contingent A w f means f is true at w and false at some accessible world. Explained A w f means some fact is admitted as a reason for f at w. Explains is an interpreted parameter, not assumed causal, transitive, asymmetric, well-founded, contrastive or necessitating.
